newsitem.title: USA: Central Tractor agrees to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: Central Tractor agrees to be acquired.

text.p: Central Tractor Farm & Country Inc said it and J.W. Childs Equity Partners LP entered into a definitive merger agreement under which J.W. Childs will acquire Central Tractor in a two-stage transaction.
The public holders of Central Tractor will receive $14.25 per share in cash in the merger. The total value of the transaction is about $156 million.
The board of Central Tractor has unanimously approved the merger agreement.

According to an agreement executed at the same time with the merger by J.W. Childs and affiliates of Butler Capital Corp, Butler's affiliates have sold 1,048,214 Central Tractor shares (9.9 perecent of the outstanding shares) to Childs at $14.00 per share and agreed to sell their remaining Central Tractor shares to Childs upon receipt of antitrust approval for $14.00 per share.
Affiliates of Butler own 64.5 percent of Central Tractor's outstanding common stock.

The agreement provides that following the acquisition by Childs of all of the Central Tractor shares held by the Butler affiliates, Childs will effect a merger with the company in which the remaining shares of Central Tractor held by public stockholders will be acquired for $14.25 per share.
Central Tractor is an agricultural specialty retailer that owns 111 stores in 16 states.
